LDC1612 i2c register-aware responses with intb pin held low so the firmware sees the chip as always having data ready. The simavr patch makes SET_EXTERNAL propagate immediately, so driving an input pin externally now works for sensor data-ready / interrupt pins.

  REG_MANUFACTURER_ID 0x7e -> 0x5449 (TI)
  REG_DEVICE_ID       0x7f -> 0x3055 (LDC1612)
  REG_DATA0_MSB       0x00 -> 0x0147  (top 16 bits of measurement)
  REG_DATA0_LSB       0x01 -> 0xa65e  (bottom 16 bits)
The combined 32-bit value 0x0147a65e has error_bits=0 and a non-zero magnitude that maps via the cfg's calibration table to a stable z-position around 1.0 mm.
